level.label: A₁ crosses into its memory lane

events.text: Routing begins (ticks 0–10). The train of K = 4 slots (A₁ at the front, D₁ at the tail) enters the input port one site per tick. On the edges of level d the address-transmission gate Û⁽ᵈ⁾, controlled by A_d, flips the colour of every walker behind A_d when A_d is red. At each bifurcation Ŝ sends red walkers left (bit 0) and blue walkers right (bit 1), resetting them to red.
A₁ enters the tree at the input port (edge (1,1), site 1) (in 1 of 2 branches).

D₁ enters the tree at the input port (edge (1,1), site 1) (in every branch).

Query (ticks 11–11). Every walker rests in a memory lane (each slot on its own lane site). The global copy gates fire on the clock in every cell but act only where the flag D₀ is present and red, i.e. in the cell(s) addressed by the input. The local copy Û_copy^loc(D_j|M_j) erases the data walker D_j (R → ∅) where the stored bit b_j = 0 and leaves it red where b_j = 1.
Û_copy⁽ᵃ⁾ [D₁] acts in the lane(s) where D₀ is red (in every branch): the local copy erases D₁ in 5 branch(es).

Spurious walker: Û_copy⁽ᵃ⁾ [D₁] acted on the empty site (3, 2, 1) in branch |00⟩′3, where no walker of the train sits, and created a red walker (|∅⟩ → |R⟩, technical paper, Eq. (locCopy)). It shares the time bin of D₁, which is elsewhere, so it is a stray.

End of the query: every walker reverses its direction; the inverse routing replays the forward schedule backwards in time.

Inverse routing (ticks 12–22): the exact time reversal of routing. The train retraces its path tail-first; Ŝ† merges the paths at every bifurcation (a red walker arriving from the right child turns blue) and the same gates fire again in reverse order, recollecting the dispersed address walkers. All 2 levels are undone and the walkers leave through the port they entered.

paper.source: the technical paper, §Basic variant, Resource scaling

notes: Engine edges host the control plus every slot behind it: n_sites(d) = K − d + 1 (paper: n + m − d); the difference is a constant per level.
The memory lane hosts the whole train at rest: T_total = 2·T_fwd + T_q, not the paper's pass-through depth constant.
